title: Public Fall Colors Cruise on Lake Minnetonka
blurb:
Discover the stunning scenery of Lake Minnetonka on this 90-minute Public Champagne Sightseeing Cruise. Sip on a complimentary drink while soaking in the beautiful views. The heated and air-conditioned boat ensures a comfortable experience year-round, whether you're enjoying the fall colors or the summer sun. Perfect for families and friends, this cruise is a great way to relax and unwind on the water. Additional snacks and drinks are available for purchase to enhance your outing.

- 90-minute scenic cruise on Lake Minnetonka
- Includes a drink ticket for beer, wine, or soft drink
- Heated and air-conditioned boats for comfort
- Great for families, with discounted rates for children
